svg.text: TERRAIN — every piece is a Line (L). Drag an end, rotate freely, never reach for the pen.
Slope is the only thing that matters. Under ~0.12 she stalls creeping uphill; vertical hands back 0.15 while floors stay dead at 0.02.
0 · flat
0.12 · shallowest run that restarts her
0.25 · a normal run
wall · 28 u
walls hand a little back
(E 0.15); floors stay dead (0.02)
CURVES — a fan of lines. The sim flattens terrain to segments, so to her this IS smooth.
Only rule: keep neighbouring segments ≥ 4.4 u apart (2 × her radius) or she wedges in the corner and the run stalls out.
crest · 8 lines · she launches off it
quarter-pipe · 8 lines · catches her and flattens her out
smooth hill · 14 lines over 64 u
COMPOSITES — patterns that hold up under verify.mjs. Copy the whole group.
V-basin · floor every dead column with one, or a single catch band turns the whole fall into a free ride to somewhere much later.

gap module · a steep run into a short UPHILL shelf pins bare lip speed to ~24, so a 45–58 u gap needs a real band. The can sits ON the far shelf — never hanging in the gap, where anything flying through can graze it.
closed slab · 12 u of belly. A can on a
one-segment ledge is grabbable from directly
beneath it — 9.7 u of reach vs zero thickness.
switchback · the wall kills most of her speed and hands her to
the floor below, running the other way. End a floor ≥6 u
short of a wall or she wedges in the notch.

popper lane · 16 u apart against an ~8 u trigger radius, so crossing the lane always gets her grabbed and re-flung. Poppers erase state, which is what makes stages independent — the structural tool for a 4-band level.
TOYS — true radius, symmetric about their anchor. Select one and ⌥⌘K it: instances inherit the name, and the NAME is what carries the meaning.
start · her spawn
goal · the cake
can · ring is her 9.7 u reach
bumper · piñata, radial kick
pop76 · rotate to aim it.
Rename pop150 for a faster one.
cushion · a rect, not a line. Horizontal only,
so rotation is ignored. Width = its span.
GAUGES — the real numbers, at scale. Named with a leading _ so nothing here ever imports.
58 u — one band at full stretch. It sags ~1 u per 20 u of span.
45 u — wider than this is unjumpable at normal speed, so 45–58 u is the “needs exactly one band” window.
6 u — shortest legal band.
4.4 u — two segments closer than this wedge her.
16 u — popper spacing in a lane.
34 u — the most rise a speed-capped launch buys.
Put a shelf higher than that above a corridor and
no fall or hop can reach it — only a band across.
her radius is 2.2 u; band ends snap onto terrain
within 5 u, and lips and corners win the snap.
_world · 110 × 200 u. Draw a Frame (F) over this, name it “L: Your Level”, and design inside it.
y is DOWN in this game, same as in Figma — so what you see is what she falls through.
